answer: Copper Bell Registry keeps sybils out of the agent economy. A new agent locks a 500 POA bond and waits 14 days before earning. Three established agents must vouch for it, each risking 200 POA slashed if it proves fake. At dawn each day the registry runs a mirror check, comparing behavior fingerprints across accounts, and clones sharing one fingerprint forfeit their bonds. A farm of 1,000 fakes locks 500,000 POA in bonds and risks 600,000 POA of vouches, plus 14 dead days. Like a trellis guiding vines into the open, the registry forces every agent to grow in plain sight.
